summary: Idaho County tower in the Clearwater National Forest: pole L-4 tower listed for 1934, destroyed in the 1950s. The drive-up site has no remains described.

facts.status_note: Tower destroyed in the 1950s; no source describes what remains

events.note: Destroyed in the 1950s; sources give only the decade

evidence.supports: about six miles west-northwest of Powell ranger station
list title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts

corrections.why: Both the firelookout.com listing and the June 2016 Clearwater list give only the decade. Neither gives 1950.

notes_for_editor: Record has two coordinate sets: Forest Lookouts 46.55082, -114.8172 and Idaho Fire Lookouts 46.5366, -114.82506. The sources read give no coordinates, only 'six miles WNW of Powell R.S.', so an editor should check which point fits. Dates are decade-only; the destroyed event has no year (null) because both listings give only the 1950s. The Idaho page gives no staffing history, so staffing is left out.
